d: Cyclone Arnab is expected to make landfall along the north Andhra Pradesh coast on October 28, with wind speeds of 115–125 kmph and gusts reaching 140 kmph. Andhra Pradesh and Odisha have stepped up emergency preparedness, deploying disaster response teams, closing schools in vulnerable Odisha districts and restricting access to beaches and other high-risk areas. Authorities have ordered round-the-clock vigilance as heavy to extremely heavy rainfall is forecast in parts of the region.
